items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Plans $5 Billion Bond Sale For AI Expansion
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS: AMD) is preparing a multi billion dollar investment grade bond sale of up to US$5b to support AI related expansion. It plans to direct a significant share of the proceeds toward AI infrastructure, including a major partnership with Anthropic. If completed, this would be AMD's largest corporate bond offering to date and would extend its AI plans beyond internal product spending or acquisitions.
